messages:
leo (finance): LatticeScale INV-2026-789 ($9,450) is past due. AP said they'd pay but haven't sent remittance. Can AE confirm PTP or proof? We need either payment or a formal PTP by EOD tomorrow.

nina (acct-exec): Pinged Sam at AP earlier. They're asking for an adjusted invoice with bank details in the PO field. Sent revised invoice 10m ago.

sam (LatticeScale AP): Hi all, sorry for the delay. Procurement required the bank info in the PO for our ERP. We've queued the wire for tomorrow morning 09:00 local. If we can do a split (50% now, rest tomorrow) would that avoid a hold?

leo (finance): 50% works as short-term. Need at least $4,725 posted by 2026-03-15 08:00 UTC with proof (screenshot or remittance). Mask full account numbers. If full amount clears tomorrow we'll apply a one-time $150 courtesy credit.
nina (acct-exec): Adding: offered credit in writing. Sam, can you confirm acceptance of the $150 credit for same-day full payment?

sam (LatticeScale AP): Confirmed — we accept the $150 credit if wire completes 03/15 AM. I'll upload remittance screenshot after bank sends confirmation.
jules (legal): Note — per Master Services Agreement we can apply a late fee of 1% per 30 days. We'll hold off on fees if promo credit + payment happens as agreed. If PTP missed, we escalate per collections workflow after 7 days.
devops (ops): Heads-up: if account is suspended we will throttle batch jobs for the integration tier; uptime may be impacted. I can prepare a rollback plan once payment shows.

collections-bot: Billing hold scheduled for account "lattice-scale" on 2026-03-15 08:00 UTC if balance > $0. Use `/payments status INV-2026-789` to refresh.

leo (finance): Thanks. @nina paste masked remittance here when you get it and I'll clear the pending hold. I'll also email the credit confirmation to Sam and cc this thread.

nina (acct-exec): Got bank note: Wire executed 03/15 09:05 CET (our timezone check shows it posts ~03/15 07:00 UTC). Bank confirmation: TXN-998812. Uploading remittance (masked): "REMIT: WIRE - ****4321 - INV-2026-789 - AMT $9,450 - TXN-998812"

sam (LatticeScale AP): Confirm bank notified me. Thanks for the flexibility.

leo (finance): Received remittance. Clearing hold and applying $150 credit. Will update account notes and close once funds clear in ledger.
jules (legal): Documenting waiver and credit on account.
devops (ops): Will standby to re-enable any paused jobs once ledger shows settled.

collections-bot: Payment for INV-2026-789 marked pending settlement. Run `/payments refresh 2167003210` to check final posting.

leo (finance): Closing thread pending settlement. If settlement fails by 03/17 EOD reopen and trigger escalation. :white_check_mark:
